Breadth-first search (BFS)
Visit reachable graph nodes in increasing distance from a start using a queue.
Queue එJකන් මුලින් ආ node එක process කරන්න. Neighbor එක enqueue කරද්දීමෙ visited mark කරන්න.

A · Visit order · A B C D · B C · Queue: first in, first out · D · Follow directed edges from A. The visited order depends on the neighbor order shown. Input එJකන් result එක දකේවා state Jවනස් Jවන ආකාරය බලන්න.
Expected result: For graph A→B,C; B→D; C→D, BFS(A) → A,B,C,D
Complexity / cost: O(V+E) time; O(V) space
Interview Q & A: When does BFS find shortest paths? Unweighted graphs or equal edge costs.
Memory trick: visit: A → B → C → D — trace the example before coding.
Practice: Return distance and predecessor maps.
